**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.06` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Inventory domain-specific sources such as medical, legal, financial, scientific and accessibility datasets, with their sensitivity and access gates.

## Deliverables

- Inventory of specialized domain sources with access gates
- Sensitivity notes per source

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/sources/specialized.md`
- `catalog/proposals/`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each gated source records its public access-gate description

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Restricted or credentialed sources record only public metadata
- [ ] Sensitive-domain candidates carry an explicit sensitivity flag
- [ ] Candidates are proposals only

## Non-goals

- Applying for credentialed access
- Handling protected health or personal data

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.06.T1` Inventory domains
  - [ ] `DATA-02.06.T1.S1` List domain sources by sector
  - [ ] `DATA-02.06.T1.S2` Record access gates and credential requirements
- [ ] `DATA-02.06.T2` Record sensitivity
  - [ ] `DATA-02.06.T2.S1` Flag sensitive domains
  - [ ] `DATA-02.06.T2.S2` Record public consent or ethics statements

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-02.01` Discovery method and source-use policy
- Blocked by `DATA-05.03` Consent, privacy and personal data

## Review requirements

- Rights reviewer
- Privacy reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

## Cross-repository handoffs

- None.
